widgets_values:
Sample graph: Multy_prompts plus Krea 2 Identity Edit v1.2.

Diffusion model is KREA2/krea2_turbo_fp8_scaled.safetensors.
Identity LoRA #37, KREA2/krea2_identity_edit_v1_2.safetensors at strength 1, comes first.
Xenoflora stack #46 at 0.75 comes after it, on the model and on the positive CLIP.
The negative grounded encode stays on the CLIP loader.
Positive stays Krea2 Edit grounded encode. Do not swap it for the text-to-image encoder.
Source patch: fit, ref_boost 4, aligned (trained). Grounding_px 1024.
Sampler is euler, simple, 8 steps, CFG 1, denoise 1. That is the Turbo schedule.
Start Loop mode is List. Sampler seed control stays fixed. Each plate uses its own seed.
Output is 768x1376.
Load Image is example.png. Point it at a full-body photo.
Second reference node 47 is off until "2nd ref ON" is true. See the note under that image.

widgets_values:
2nd reference is OFF until "2nd ref ON" is true. Off uses the original single photo. The other branches do not run.

"2nd ref is STYLE" matters only while the second ref is on.

Off = character. Image 2 joins the identity edit as the subject. Image 1 stays the first reference.

On = style, for a face photo plus an abstract material (car paint, a texture).
The face stays the subject: beside the canvas, ref_boost 4, so a tight face crop is not pinned huge.
The abstract image is material only: bag of features, ref_boost_a 3. That dial is the paint strength. Lower it if the face slips. Raise it if the car paint is too weak.
The identity edit patch stays on. The separate style LoRA is not used here, because it was dropping the face.

Point "2nd reference" at the abstract image. The person photo stays in "person photo".
